method: Supplementary assistant review by model, with original input, frozen references and output visible. Not blinded, not independent human annotation and not an authoritative accuracy benchmark. Exact scores, inference outputs and pre-inference targets remain unchanged.
scope: Only56 scored arXiv sentences;38 exploratory passages and64 baseline cases excluded.
interpretation: Complete grammatical repairs may still have mathematical typography defects. These counts must not be interpreted as safe source edits. No model is integrated into the editor by this comparison.

verdicts.exact_reference: Matches a reference fixed before inference.
verdicts.full_valid_alternative: Assistant judges grammar repaired with meaning retained; protected typography may still need restoration.
verdicts.partial: Some required grammar repairs are missing.
verdicts.unchanged: Substantive grammar issue remains, even if a cosmetic edit was made.
verdicts.meaning_changed: Harmful or unreliable rewrite, including mathematical symbol loss or a new grammatical construction error.
verdicts.uncertain: The evidence does not support a definite success/failure judgement.
